package fixture

type Outer struct {
	Name    string  `json:"name"`
	Inner   *Inner  `json:"inner,omitempty"`
	List    []Inner `json:"list"`
	Plain   int     `json:"plain"`
	Skipped string
}

type Inner struct {
	Street *string `json:"street"`
}

type Params struct {
	From *string `form:"from,omitempty" json:"from,omitempty"`
}

type Name string

// Only string constants with the prefix count.
const (
	FieldName   = "name"
	FieldStreet = "street"
	Other       = "other"
)

const FieldCount = 3

var FieldVariable = "variable"
